response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with a strong background in TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and full-stack systems, but his resume shows minimal hands-on Java/Kotlin/JVM work and no evidence of Spring ecosystem, enterprise application server, or IDE-internals experience, all of which are core requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level engineering experience across many domains and companies
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, clean architecture)
History of public speaking, teaching, and open-source contribution showing strong communication skills
concerns: No demonstrated recent experience with Java, Kotlin, or the Spring ecosystem
No evidence of IDE internals, language tooling, or build-tool/app-server integration work
Career shows broad generalist trajectory rather than deep JVM/enterprise tooling specialization

key_factors.factor: No IDE internals or language tooling background
Strong general software engineering seniority and craftsmanship
